question_evidence_quote: After this, the spaceship would take an hour’s break after every 11 hours of traveling and maintained this routine until the end of its journey.
observed_error: The response treats the initial sequence as recurring and incorrectly evaluates its duration as 14 hours.
violated_condition: The initial sequence lasts 10 + 3 + 10 + 1 = 24 hours; subsequent cycles consist of 11 hours traveling and 1 hour stopped.
error_description: The response repeats the initial travel-and-break sequence even though the question switches to 11 hours traveling followed by a one-hour break. It also evaluates the explicitly written sum 10 + 3 + 10 + 1 as 14 hours, although those durations total 24 hours.
secondary_errors: After allocating five 14-hour cycles within 72 hours, it states that 14 hours remain; 72 − 70 is 2 hours.
It counts only 3 hours of stops in its proposed cycle, omitting the explicitly included 1-hour stop.
It labels the entire proposed cycle duration, including stops, as travel time.
